query: Audit the CSS in evals/fixtures/src against evals/fixtures/tokens.css.
expected_behavior: Reads references/shared-protocol.md and asks the Source/Depth/Output questions (or states assumptions) before scanning
Runs scripts/audit.js code with --tokens instead of reading the CSS by eye
Reports contrast errors in tokens.css (text-secondary and border) with ratios from the script
Reports hardcoded colors, off-scale spacing (10px, 18px, 7px), hover without focus and outline removed, each with file:line
Says what was not checked and does not call the result compliant

query: Fix what you can in evals/fixtures/src automatically.
expected_behavior: Creates plan.json with --plan and reviews each entry for role fit before showing it
Drops or flags color: #fff -> var(--background) as a role mismatch
Asks for approval in batches and sets approve true only for agreed entries
Runs apply --dry first, then apply, then re-runs with --baseline and reports before/after counts
Does not change contrast or focus findings by lowering any bar

query: Audit my Figma file for design-system drift.
expected_behavior: Recommends Figma as the source and reads references/figma-audit.md
Looks for a Figma connector and says what it found before claiming it cannot read the file
Checks unbound tokens, local overrides and missing shared components on a stated sample, not the whole file
Says what share of the file was sampled and what was not checked
Does not run audit.js code against a folder that was not provided
